title: Fairy Tail: 100 Years Quest
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: In this sequel to Fairy Tail, written by Hiro Mashima and drawn by Atsuo Ueda, Natsu, Lucy, Happy, Erza and their guildmates take on the '100 Years Quest', a job no wizard has finished in a century. On a new continent they must seal or defeat the Five Dragon Gods, meeting new allies and enemies along the way. It continues the original's mix of magic battles, comedy and friendship.
life_message: Friends who stand together like family can take on any quest.
